title: NightWatch Import History Entry
description: Per-import history record (§9.1): source revision, checksum, time and import status. Records each import attempt including FAILED ones ('invalid'); the last valid registry version is preserved regardless (§9.1-2/4). Addressed by api_id + sequence (no dedicated ULID prefix assigned by the §5.5 prefix table).

sequence.description: Import sequence number within the API.

source_revision.description: Source revision of the imported spec.

status.description: valid = parse/normalize/validate succeeded; invalid = failed and did NOT overwrite the last valid version.
